children.name: mobile-safari
accessibility.spec.ts
Accessibility Basics
A11Y-01 signup form is fully keyboard-navigable
A11Y-02 icon-only quantity buttons have accessible names
A11Y-03 back button exposes an accessible label
A11Y-04 focus outline is visible on interactive elements
api.spec.ts
API-integrated
API-01 signup returns a user object and JWT
API-02 login with correct credentials returns a token
API-03 GET /api/doctors returns seeded doctors with slots
API-04 GET /api/medicines returns seeded catalog with rx flag
API-05 GET /api/medicines?q= filters server-side
API-06 booking an appointment persists and is retrievable via GET /me
API-07 booking with an invalid doctor id returns 404, not a crash
API-08 trial matching returns only trials in the eligible age range
API-09 trial matching rejects an out-of-range age with 400
API-11 signup rejects a name over 120 characters with a clean 400
API-12 signup accepts a name at exactly the 120-character boundary
API-13 every listed doctor has at least one bookable slot
auth.spec.ts
Auth — Negative & Data-Driven (client-side validation)
NEG-01 empty login is blocked with validation
NEG-02 invalid email format is rejected: "plainaddress"
NEG-02 invalid email format is rejected: "missing@domain"
NEG-02 invalid email format is rejected: "@nodomain.com"
NEG-02 invalid email format is rejected: "spaces in@email.com"
NEG-03 signup blocks when passwords don't match
NEG-04 signup blocks password under 8 characters
NEG-05 signup blocks empty full name
E2E-01 successful signup lands on home
Auth — Server-side validation (real MySQL-backed API)
NEG-12 signup rejects an email that's already registered
NEG-13 login rejects a correct email with the wrong password
NEG-14 login rejects an email that was never registered
booking.spec.ts
Telehealth Booking
E2E-02 book an appointment happy path
NEG-06 cannot book without selecting a time slot
DDT-01 booking works for every doctor's first available slot
REG-01 booked appointment reflects on home dashboard
debug-booking.spec.ts
DEBUG booking flow — full network/console dump
lifecycle.spec.ts
App Lifecycle
LFC-01 a full page reload does not silently keep a stale session
LFC-02 logging in again after a reload works normally
Interrupt (web-equivalent)
INT-01 the app never pushes browser history state, so Back/Forward cannot step through screens
INT-02 tab losing and regaining visibility mid-flow doesn't lose in-progress state
navigation.spec.ts
Navigation & Cross-Device
NAV-01 each nav tab routes to its own screen
NAV-02 back arrow returns to the previous screen
XDV-01 mobile toggle renders bottom tab bar
XDV-02 desktop toggle renders side navigation
XDV-03 core flow renders consistently across browsers/viewports
performance_and_device.spec.ts
Performance
PERF-01 app shell loads within acceptable time
PERF-02 pharmacy catalog renders without long tasks blocking input
Device Behavior
DEV-01 app tolerates a network drop after initial data load
DEV-02 state resets cleanly via Reset demo data
pharmacy.spec.ts
Pharmacy
SMK-05 medicine search returns matching results
NEG-07 search with no matches shows empty state
NEG-08 out-of-stock medicine cannot be added to cart
E2E-03 add OTC medicine to cart and adjust quantity
E2E-04 full checkout with Rx item requires prescription upload
NEG-09 checkout rejects too-short card number
NEG-09 checkout rejects invalid month
NEG-09 checkout rejects too-short CVV
DDT-02 total price updates correctly across quantity changes
security.spec.ts
API-integrated (unauthenticated)
SEC-03 booking without a token is rejected with 401
SEC-04 fetching my appointments without a token is rejected with 401
SEC-05 a malformed/tampered token is rejected, not silently accepted
SEC-06 a token signed with the wrong secret is rejected
SEC-07 expressing trial interest without a token is rejected with 401
Security — injection & XSS safety
SEC-08 SQL-injection-style search input is treated as a literal string
SEC-09 an XSS payload in the booking reason is stored inert, never executed
Security response headers
SEC-10 API responses carry standard security headers and don't advertise the framework
Authentication & input hardening
SEC-11 login failure is identical for a wrong password and an unknown email (no user enumeration)
SEC-12 auth responses never expose the password or its hash
SEC-13 an unsigned (alg=none) token is rejected
SEC-14 a valid token with a tampered payload (privilege swap) is rejected
SEC-15 extra signup fields (id, role) are ignored - no mass assignment
SEC-16 a malformed JSON body gets a clean 400, not a 500
SEC-17 wrong-typed JSON field is a 400, not a 500 (login: password as object)
SEC-17 wrong-typed JSON field is a 400, not a 500 (login: password as number)
SEC-17 wrong-typed JSON field is a 400, not a 500 (signup: name as number)
SEC-17 wrong-typed JSON field is a 400, not a 500 (signup: password as number)
SEC-17 wrong-typed JSON field is a 400, not a 500 (signup: password as array)
Password policy & brute-force protection
SEC-18 signup rejects the weak password "12345678"
SEC-18 signup rejects the weak password "abcdefgh"
SEC-18 signup rejects the weak password "password"
SEC-18 signup rejects the weak password "ABCDEFGH"
SEC-19 repeated wrong passwords lock that account (429) without affecting other accounts
SEC-20 failed attempts against an unknown email lock too, so the lock reveals nothing
Input validation — appointments & orders
SEC-21 booking rejects bad input with 400 (doctorId as array)
SEC-21 booking rejects bad input with 400 (doctorId as object)
SEC-21 booking rejects bad input with 400 (slot as number)
SEC-21 booking rejects bad input with 400 (reason as object)
SEC-21 booking rejects bad input with 400 (reason over 500 characters)
SEC-22 order rejects bad input with 400, not 500 (items contains null)
SEC-22 order rejects bad input with 400, not 500 (item is a bare string)
SEC-22 order rejects bad input with 400, not 500 (qty is a string)
SEC-22 order rejects bad input with 400, not 500 (qty is fractional)
SEC-22 order rejects bad input with 400, not 500 (qty missing)
SEC-22 order rejects bad input with 400, not 500 (qty over the per-line cap)
SEC-22 order rejects bad input with 400, not 500 (medicineId as object)
SEC-22 order rejects bad input with 400, not 500 (address as number)
SEC-22 order rejects bad input with 400, not 500 (zip as number)
SEC-23 splitting one medicine across order lines cannot exceed its stock
Injection on auth, trials & profile fields
SEC-24 SQL-injection strings in login credentials never authenticate
SEC-25 a SQL-injection payload in the name is stored literally and the schema survives
SEC-26 an XSS payload in the name is rendered as text, never executed
SEC-27 trial match and interest endpoints treat injection strings as data
Authorization — trial interests are private
SEC-28 one user's trial interest is not visible to another user
SEC-29 interest in a trial that does not exist is a 404, not a crash
smoke.spec.ts
Smoke
SMK-01 app loads with auth screen
SMK-02 signup with valid details reaches home
SMK-03 all bottom nav tabs load without error
SMK-04 logout returns to auth screen

story-criteria.spec.ts
Story: book a doctor appointment
BOOK-2 booking without a slot is rejected with the documented message
BOOK-3 a slot the doctor does not offer is rejected
BOOK-4 the reason is optional
BOOK-5 a booking is visible to its owner only
Story: order medicine with prescription gating
RX-2 an order with an Rx item is rejected until the prescription is confirmed
RX-3 an order with only non-Rx items needs no prescription
RX-4 a placed order is visible to its owner only
